research_question: For eligible, independently sampled circuit families in a declared software-triage population, how well do the frozen detection, cause-disposition, localization, and abstention procedures perform under a prespecified observation design?

target_population.definition: A finite, versioned sampling frame specifying circuit source/release or generator revision, supported operations, structural strata, and eligibility dates/rules.
target_population.current_evidence: No complete reconciled independent family frame; current inventory has zero proven eligible fresh roots and is truncated.

intended_use.definition: Specify one operational use and the cost of false positive, false negative, misattribution, localization error, abstention, unsupported input, and execution failure.
intended_use.limits: No deployment or safety-critical use is supported by current evidence.

independence.unit: circuit family plus complete source/generator lineage
not_independent_units: templates derived from one recipe root
independence.rule: Assign all descendants of a family/lineage root to one partition; reject missing ancestry and exact or near-duplicate cross-partition families.

fields: generation_id and generator/source revision and hashes
family_root_id, lineage_root_id, complete ancestor roots and lineage evidence
canonical circuit hash and circuit/configuration hashes
random seeds and deterministic seed derivation
Python implementation/version and every relevant library/runtime version
reproduction command/configuration record hash and immutable observation artifact hash

truth_and_blinding.procedure: Independent reviewers inspect immutable source/intervention and observation evidence while blinded to method outputs and tuning choices. Resolve disagreement under a prespecified rule; retain unresolved cases as such. Keep labels and adjudication-only fields physically/logically separate from observable predictors.
truth_and_blinding.limits: Source syntax difference alone is not proof of behavioral causation; simulator-injected hardware scenarios are not physical hardware truth.

partitions.train: Whole development families for method construction.
partitions.calibration: Disjoint families for any calibration or threshold selection; do not imply calibration has occurred.
partitions.test: Untouched, sealed family/lineage-disjoint validation set opened only after protocol, code, thresholds, and analysis are frozen.
partitions.frozen_acceptance: The existing 45-case acceptance set remains separate, unchanged, and cannot be used for selection.

additional: cause-disposition and single-cause attribution accuracy on eligible truth
source and hardware localization metrics reported separately
endpoints.uncertainty: Report family-cluster-aware intervals; shots and descendants are repeated measures, not independent sample size.
endpoints.calibration: If probabilistic outputs are introduced, predeclare calibration metrics and evaluate only on a disjoint calibration set; current outputs are not established calibrated probabilities.

required_before_sampling: use-specific acceptable false-positive/false-negative and misattribution costs
effect/null margins and class-wise performance criteria
decision_criteria.rule: Freeze criteria before opening untouched test outcomes; do not derive numeric floors from the frozen 45 cases.

inputs: independent family sampling frame and inclusion probabilities
planned intervals, multiplicity, abstention and missingness
minimum meaningful differences and resource ceilings
power_analysis.current_claim: No defensible numeric power or sample size is available until these inputs are independently established.

resources_and_recovery.limits: Set maximum family count, circuit executions, shots, runtime, peak memory, storage/output size, and cost before execution.
stop_rules: stop before any reservation exceeds a declared cap
stop on provenance, lineage, partition, schema, integrity, or runtime failure
preserve partial checkpoint with exact source/config/runtime identity
resume only if hashes and frozen settings match
resources_and_recovery.authorization: A protocol or local validator does not authorize study execution, external services, or hardware.

confirmatory_prerequisites: independent blinded adjudicators and immutable evidence
independently reviewed and protocol-bound attestation verified under an external trust policy
frozen use-specific criteria and family-level power/resource analysis
gates.current_disposition: BLOCKED: external family-frame reconciliation, reviewers/adjudication, external protocol review, acceptance decisions, validated power/resource assumptions, and any study authorization are absent.

implementation.boundary: The validator checks record structure and recorded prerequisites only; it cannot establish truth quality, actual independence, signature authenticity, power, performance, or external validity.

case_fields: protocol version and frozen protocol SHA-256
immutable evidence_refs with stable IDs and SHA-256
execution_ids nested within one family case
at least two separately recorded judgments with evidence references
explicit agreement/disagreement disposition and hashed resolution evidence
adjudication_evidence_gate.privacy: Use opaque externally issued reviewer tokens; do not store raw reviewer names, email, or usernames. A trusted external attestation binds token, case, protocol hash, blinding, and independence.
external_trust_requirements: independently verified reviewer identity tokenization, independence, and blinding
separate externally verified blinded resolver attestation for resolved disagreement
adjudication_evidence_gate.independence_unit: One family plus lineage is at most one independent case; repeated executions remain nested and cannot increase family count.
adjudication_evidence_gate.trust_boundary: Self-declared independence/blinding fields are insufficient. The API assumes supplied verified attestations were checked by an external trust-policy verifier; it does not authenticate signatures.

reconciliation.current_limit: Reuses the persisted inventory and recovery table within documented caps; no new filesystem discovery. Inventory remains truncated/incomplete.

requires: externally verified complete inventory and frame attestations bound to exact hashes
complete per-case generation and execution provenance
verified independent blinded adjudication for every case
use-specific criteria and family-level power/resource assumptions
confirmatory_preflight.current_status: BLOCKED; no authentic external attestations or independent adjudications are present.
